Question 2
?

Which of the following represents the shaded region above as a type I region in two-dimensional space?

a
{(x,y):0≤x≤1,1≤y≤x2+3}
b
{(x,y):0≤x≤1,1≤y≤x3}
c
{(x,y):0≤x≤y−3,1≤y≤4}
d
{(x,y):0≤x≤y−3,1≤y≤3}
e
{(x,y):0≤x≤1,1≤y≤x2−3}
Submit
